verses.geez: ወኢያረምም፡ በእንተ፡ ጽዮን፡ ወኢየኀድግ፡ በእንተ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፣፡ እስከ፡ ትወፅእ፡ ጽድቅየ፡ ከመ፡ ብርሃን፡ ወተኀቱ፡ መድኃኒትየ፡ ከመ፡ ማኅቶት።
verses.translation: For Sion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as light, and my salvation burn as a torch.

translations.lxx: For Sion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as light, and my salvation burn as a torch.
translations.kjv: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
translations.ron: Pentru Sion nu voi tăcea şi pentru Ierusalim nu voi avea odihnă până ce dreptatea lui nu va ieşi ca lumina şi mântuirea lui nu va arde ca o flacără.
translations.grk: Διὰ Σιὼν οὐ σιωπήσομαι, καὶ διὰ Ἱερουσαλὴμ οὐκ ἀνήσω, ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθῃ ὡς φῶς ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτῆς, τὸ δὲ σωτήριόν μου ὡς λαμπὰς καυθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወይሬእዩ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ጽድቀኪ፡ ወነገሥትኒ፡ ስብሐተኪ፡ ወይሰመይ፡ ስመኪ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር፡ ሰመየኪ።
verses.translation: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and kings thy glory: and one shall call thee by a new name, which the Lord shall name.

translations.lxx: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and kings thy glory: and one shall call thee by a new name, which the Lord shall name.
translations.kjv: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
translations.ron: Atunci neamurile vor vedea dreptatea ta şi toţi regii slava ta şi te vor chema pe tine cu nume nou, pe care îl va rosti gura Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὄψονται ἔθνη τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου, καὶ βασιλεῖς τὴν δόξαν σου, καὶ καλέσει σε τὸ ὄνομα τὸ καινὸν, ὃ ὁ Κύριος ὀνομάσει αὐτό.

verses.geez: ወትከውኒ፡ አክሊለ፡ ሠናየ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወቀጸላ፡ መንግሥት፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ አምላክኪ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
translations.ron: Şi tu vei fi ca o cunună de mărire în mâna Domnului şi ca o diademă regală în mâna Dumnezeului tău.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσῃ στέφανος κάλλους ἐν χειρὶ Κυρίου, καὶ διάδημα βασιλείας ἐν χειρὶ Θεοῦ σου.

verses.geez: ወኢትሰመዪ፡ እንከ፡ ኅድግተ፡ ወኢትሰመይ፡ እንከ፡ ምድርኪ፡ በድወ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt no more be called Forsaken; and thy land shall no more be called Desert: for thou shalt be called My Pleasure, and thy land Inhabited: for the Lord has taken pleasure in thee, and thy land shall be inhabited.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt no more be called Forsaken; and thy land shall no more be called Desert: for thou shalt be called My Pleasure, and thy land Inhabited: for the Lord has taken pleasure in thee, and thy land shall be inhabited.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
translations.ron: Şi nu ţi se va mai zice ţie: "Alungată", şi ţării tale: "Pustiită", ci tu te vei chema: "Întru tine am binevoit" şi ţara ta: "Cea cu bărbat", că Domnul a binevoit întru tine şi pământul tău va avea un soţ.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκέτι κληθήσῃ Καταλελειμμένη, καὶ ἡ γῆ σου οὐ κληθήσεται ἔτι Ἔρημος· σοὶ γὰρ κληθήσεται, Θέλημα ἐμὸν, καὶ τῇ γῇ σου, Οἰκουμένη, ὅτι εὐδόκησε Κύριος ἐν σοὶ, καὶ ἡ γῆ σου συνοικισθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ይነብር፡ ወሬዛ፡ ምስለ፡ ድንግል፡ ከማሁ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ደቂቅኪ፤ ወከመ፡ ይትፌሣሕ፡ መርዓዊ፡ በመርዓቱ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይትፌሣሕ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ብኪ።
verses.translation: And as a young man lives with a virgin, so shall thy sons dwell in thee: and it shall come to pass that as a bridegroom will rejoice over a bride, so will the Lord rejoice over thee.

translations.lxx: And as a young man lives with a virgin, so shall thy sons dwell in thee: and it shall come to pass that as a bridegroom will rejoice over a bride, so will the Lord rejoice over thee.
translations.kjv: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
translations.ron: Şi în ce chip se însoreşte flăcăul cu fecioara, Cel ce te-a zidit Se va însoţi cu tine, şi în ce chip mirele se veseleşte de mireasă, aşa Se va veseli de tine Dumnezeul tău!
translations.grk: Καὶ ὡς συνοικῶν νεανίσκος παρθένῳ, οὕτω κατοικήσουσιν οἱ υἱοί σου· καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον εὐφρανθήσεται νυμφίος ἐπὶ νύμφῃ, οὕτως εὐφρανθήσεται Κύριος ἐπὶ σοί.

verses.geez: ወአነብር፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፡ መዓቅበ፡ ዲበ፡ አረፋትኪ፡ መዓልተ፡ ወሌሊተ፡ እለ፡ ኢያረምሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይዜከርዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: And on thy walls, O Jerusalem, have I set watchmen all day and all night, who shall never cease making mention of the Lord.

translations.lxx: And on thy walls, O Jerusalem, have I set watchmen all day and all night, who shall never cease making mention of the Lord.
translations.kjv: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
translations.ron: Pe zidurile tale, Ierusalime, Eu pun străjeri, care nici zi, nici noapte nu vor tăcea! Voi, care aduceţi aminte Domnului de făgăduinţele Lui, să n-aveţi odihnă!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν τειχῶν σου Ἱερουσαλὴμ κατέστησα φύλακας ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν καὶ ὅλην τὴν νύκτα, οἳ διὰ τέλους οὐ σιωπήσονται μιμνησκόμενοι Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ኢታርምሙ፡ ሎቱ፡ እስከ፡ ይሠርዕ፡ ወእስከ፡ ይሬሲ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: For there is none like you, when he shall have established, and made Jerusalem a praise on the earth.

translations.lxx: For there is none like you, when he shall have established, and made Jerusalem a praise on the earth.
translations.kjv: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
translations.ron: Şi să nu-I daţi răgaz până ce nu va aşeza din nou Ierusalimul, ca să facă din el lauda pământului.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἔστι γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅμοιος· ἐὰν διορθώσῃ, καὶ ποιήσῃ Ἱερουσαλὴμ γαυρίαμα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez: መሐለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በስብሐቲሁ፡ ወበኃይለ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይሁብ፡ እንከ፡ እክለኪ፡ ወስርነናየኪ፡ ለፀር፣፡ ወአኢይሰትይዎ፡ እንከ፡ ፀር፡ ለዓለም፡ ለወይንኪ፡ ዘተገበርኪ።
verses.translation: For the Lord has sworn by his glory, and by the might of his arm, I will no more give thy corn and thy provisions to thine enemies; nor shall strangers any more drink thy wine, for which thou hast laboured.

translations.lxx: For the Lord has sworn by his glory, and by the might of his arm, I will no more give thy corn and thy provisions to thine enemies; nor shall strangers any more drink thy wine, for which thou hast laboured.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
translations.ron: Juratu-S-a Domnul pe dreapta Lui şi pe braţul Lui cel tare: "Nu voi mai da de aici înainte grâul tău spre hrană vrăjmaşilor tăi, şi cei de neam străin, nu vor bea mustul tău, rodul muncii tale.
translations.grk: Ὤμοσε Κύριος κατὰ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ, καὶ κατὰ τῆς ἰσχύος τοῦ βραχίονος αὐτοῦ, εἰ ἔτι δώσω τὸν σῖτόν σου, καὶ τὰ βρώματα σου τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου, καὶ εἰ ἔτι πίονται υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι τὸν οἶνόν σου, ἐφʼ ᾧ ἐμόχθησας.

verses.geez: ዳእሙ፡ ዘአስተጋብኦ፡ ይበልዖ፡ ወይሴብሖ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፣፡ ወእለ፡ አስተጋብእዎ፡ ይሰትይዎ፡ በአህጉርየ፡ ቅዱሳት።
verses.translation: But they that have gathered them shall eat them, and they shall praise the Lord; and they that have gathered the grapes shall drink thereof in my holy courts.

translations.lxx: But they that have gathered them shall eat them, and they shall praise the Lord; and they that have gathered the grapes shall drink thereof in my holy courts.
translations.kjv: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
translations.ron: Ci numai cei ce îl vor fi adunat îl vor mânca şi vor lăuda pe Domnul, şi cei care vor fi făcut culesul vor bea vinul în curţile templului Meu cel sfânt!"
translations.grk: Ἀλλʼ οἱ συναγαγόντες φάγονται αὐτὰ, καὶ αἰνέσουσι Κύριον, καὶ οἱ συναγαγόντες πίονται αὐτὰ ἐν ταῖς ἐπαύλεσι ταῖς ἁγίαις μου.

verses.geez: ሖሩ፡ ባኡ፡ እንተ፡ አንቀጽየ፡ ወጺሑ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ለሕዝብየ፤ ወአእትቱ፡ እብነ፡ እምፍኖት፡ ወንሥኡ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ለአሕዛብ።
verses.translation: Go through my gates, and make a way for my people; and cast the stones out of the way; lift up a standard for the Gentiles.

translations.lxx: Go through my gates, and make a way for my people; and cast the stones out of the way; lift up a standard for the Gentiles.
translations.kjv: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
translations.ron: Intraţi, întraţi pe porţi! Gătiţi cale poporului, gătiţi, gătiţi-i drum, curăţiţi-l de pietre, înălţaţi un steag peste neamuri!
translations.grk: Πορεύεσθε διὰ τῶν πυλῶν μοῦ, καὶ ὁδοποιήσατε τῷ λαῷ μου, καὶ τοὺς λίθους ἐκ τῆς ὁδοῦ διαῤῥίψατε, ἐξάρατε σύσσημον εἰς τὰ ἔθνη.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይገብር፡ መንክረ፡ እስከ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: For behold, the Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth, say ye to the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy Saviour has come to thee, having his reward and his work before his face.

translations.lxx: For behold, the Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth, say ye to the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy Saviour has come to thee, having his reward and his work before his face.
translations.kjv: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
translations.ron: Iată, Domnul vesteşte acestea până la marginile pământului: "Ziceţi fiicei Sionului: Mântuitorul tău vine! El vine cu plata, şi răsplătirile merg înaintea Lui!"
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ γὰρ Κύριος ἐποίησεν ἀκουστὸν ἕως ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς· εἴπατε τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιὼν, ἰδοὺ ὁ σωτήρ σοι παραγέγονεν ἔχων τὸν ἑαυτοῦ μισθὸν, καὶ τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወትሰመዩ፡ ሕዝበ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ዘአድኀነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ አንቲኒ፡ ትሰመዪ፡ ቅድስተ፡ ሀገረ፡ እንተ፡ ይፈቅድዋ፡ ወአኮ፡ እንተ፡ የኀድግዋ።
verses.translation: And one shall call them the holy people, the redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called a city sought out, and not forsaken.

translations.lxx: And one shall call them the holy people, the redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called a city sought out, and not forsaken.
translations.kjv: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
translations.ron: Şi ei se vor chema: "Popor sfânt, răscumpăraţi ai Domnului şi ţie şi se va zice: "Cea căutată", "Cetatea nepărăsită!"
translations.grk: Καὶ καλέσει αὐτὸν Λαὸν ἅγιον, λελυτρωμένον ὑπὸ Κυρίου· σὺ δὲ κληθήσῃ Ἐπιζητουμένη πόλις, καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλελιμμένη.
